title: 风的转身 · 双涡流观察
audience: 数学/科学展览中的中学生与成人观众
use_context: 1500×1100横向观察展板，原尺寸近读，以箭头追踪模型曲线
user_goal: 识别两处反向涡流、观察局部方向与连接区域，区分模型和真实测量
content_basis: 显式自拟数学速度场，非真实天气/风速/流体实验数据。短程曲线为固定步长归一化Euler示踪。
visual_intent: 薄荷/暖沙短流线构成互绕场景，两个中心与右侧三个观察指令保证实际教学用途
completion_criteria: 观察任务与模型限制清楚
creative_start_scope: shared curatorial plan and following parallel construction

technique.method: Computed short streamlines and tangent arrows using Transform rectangles; finite regularizer and viewport exit prevent divergent/external geometry
technique.boundary: Numerical model, 24 seeds and at most28 steps each; no physical weather prediction or true fluid solution. Primary information is horizontal stable text.
